method: Direct visual inspection of all eight recorded layer/night states, plus UI switch and geometry-count assertions.

states.name: base-labels-off
states.observation: 基础形体与入口保留，标签关闭。

states.name: near-labels-off
states.observation: 近景增加立面细节，主要形体和树位保持。

states.name: roads-off
states.observation: 道路及前场所属图层随开关隐藏，树木仍正确显示。

states.name: paving-with-buildings-off
states.observation: 建筑隐藏后铺地和树木保持，无建筑图层依赖。

states.name: layers-restored
states.observation: 建筑与道路恢复，前场、台阶和外围树木重新同时显示。

states.name: vegetation-off
states.observation: 树木隐藏后入口链清晰，保留建筑及铺地。

states.name: vegetation-restored
states.observation: 缓存树位恢复正常，画面中树干贴合地面。

states.name: night-labels-off
states.observation: 夜景中立面亮窗及植被显示正常，入口中央前场仍留空。

limits: Side-camera foliage occlusion remains. Hiding vegetation is a geometry diagnosis, not a proposed normal scene.
